Name: Immersive Music__HUD Music Expansion Update
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][b][i][color=#ffffff]Sử dụng[/color] [color=#ff0000]Google [/color][color=#ffff00]Translate[/color] [color=#efefef]để dịch nội dung nha![/color][/i][/b][/quote][color=#8e7cc3][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]🎵 Immersive Music — Complete Edition [/i][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[b][color=#f6b26b]A Smart Music System — Making Every Moment in Stardew Valley More Alive! [/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Have you ever felt that the background music in [/color][color=#f6b26b][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/font][/color][color=#D4D4D8] has become too familiar after [u]hundreds of hours of gameplay[/u]? Do you want music to feel more [u]natural[/u], suit the environment, and continue accompanying you without constantly hearing the same old tracks again and again? [/color]
[b][color=#8e7cc3][i]Immersive Music — Complete Edition[/i][/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] was created to bring you a different music experience. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is more than just a regular background music replacement mod. [/color][b][color=#8e7cc3]Immersive Music [/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]introduces an [/color][u][color=#6aa84f]intelligent music system[/color][/u][color=#d4d4d8] capable of [/color][u][color=#00ffff]recognizing[/color][/u][color=#d4d4d8] environmental context, [/color][u][color=#00ffff]selecting[/color][/u][color=#d4d4d8] suitable [/color][color=#ffffff]music groups[/color][color=#d4d4d8], and [/color][u][color=#00ffff]automatically managing music playback[/color][/u][color=#d4d4d8] — making the world of Stardew Valley feel more alive, seamless, and emotionally engaging.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]From peaceful mornings on the farm and rainy days to cave explorations and quiet nights, the music is designed to adapt to [/color][color=#e69138][b]your journey[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][img width=364]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53735/53735-1791710403-1832642812.png[/img][/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]🌐 [/color][/b][b][color=#1155cc][size=4]Language Support[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8] 🇺🇸 English[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] 🇻🇳 Vietnamese[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] 🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese (简体中文) [[/color][b][color=#ff0000]NEW![/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]][/color]
[quote][center][size=5]🎼[i][b][color=#8e7cc3][font=Comic Sans MS]Replacing Vanilla Music[/font][/color][/b][/i][/size][/center]
[/quote][center]
[left]With a total of  [b][i][color=#8e7cc3][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]39[/font][/size][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]custom music tracks![/font][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[b][color=#8e7cc3]Complete Edition[/color][/b] offers a variety of musical options for supported environments and gameplay situations.
The music groups include:
🌱 [b][color=#93c47d]Seasonal Outdoor Music:[/color][/b] Outdoor music for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
🏖️ [b][color=#f1c232]Beach Music:[/color][/b] Dedicated music for the Beach.
🌧️ [b][color=#6d9eeb]Rain Music:[/color][/b] Custom music during rainy or stormy weather.
🎣 [b][color=#0000ff]Fishing Music:[/color][/b] Music for the fishing minigame.
⛏️ [color=#b6b6b6][b]Cave Music:[/b] [/color]Music in supported cave locations.
🏠[color=#e06666] [b]Indoor & Farmhouse Music:[/b][/color] Music options for indoor environments.
🌙 [b][color=#ffff00]Quiet Night:[/color][/b] A quiet mode for night time.
The music priority system helps determine the appropriate music group when multiple conditions occur simultaneously. You can customize the supported features to better suit [color=#e69138][b]your playstyle[/b].[/color][/left]
[/center]
[quote][center][i][b][color=#ffd966][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]✨ WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT? [/font][/size][/color][/b][/i][/center]
[/quote][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🧠[b][color=#ff00ff]Smart Environment-Based Music System![/color][/b][/font][/size]
[b][color=#8e7cc3]Immersive Music [/color][/b]does not entirely rely on a fixed list of predefined map names. Instead, the system uses [color=#00ffff][u]environmental information[/u][/color] and [color=#00ffff][u]ingame context[/u][/color] to determine the appropriate music group.
This approach [color=#00ffff][u]allows[/u][/color] the mod to work across [color=#00ffff][u]many different locations[/u][/color], including [color=#93c47d][u]locations added by expansion mods[/u][/color], without necessarily requiring each map to be configured individually. This demonstrates remarkably [color=#93c47d][b]impressive[/b][/color] compatibility with a [color=#e06666][u]wide range of mods[/u][/color].
[b][color=#ffff00]My goal:[/color][/b] to let the music adapt to the world you are exploring, rather than forcing every location to have its own configuration based solely on map names, unlike other [color=#e06666][s]outdated music mods[/s][/color].
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🔀 [color=#6d9eeb][b]Smart Shuffle — Intelligent Track Shuffling![/b][/color][/font][/size]
No more feeling like you have just finished listening to a song only to hear that [b][color=#93c47d]exact same song again immediately![/color][/b]
[color=#6d9eeb][b]Smart Shuffle[/b][/color] is an [color=#00ffff][u]intelligent system[/u][/color] that selects music from the appropriate group and minimizes immediately replaying the track you just heard. As a result, familiar locations can still offer a fresher audio experience with every [color=#93c47d][b]new exploration.[/b][/color]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🎶Customizable Music HUD![/font][/size][/color]
See what's playing with track notifications, a rotating vinyl record, and Previous/Next controls. Choose from 4 built-in themes or [color=#6aa84f][b]create[/b][/color] [b][color=#6aa84f]your own using content packs and optional PNG overlays[/color][/b]. Toggle with F8 or keep the HUD always visible through GMCM.
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]🎧 [color=#cccccc]A FAMILIAR WORLD, A DIFFERENT EXPERIENCE[/color][/font][/heading]
[b][color=#8e7cc3]Immersive Music[/color][/b] was created for those who love [b][color=#f6b26b][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley[/font][/color][/b] and want to change the original music while still making it feel like a more natural part of their journey.
Enjoy peaceful mornings, rainy days by the window, journeys exploring new lands, and quiet nights on the farm.
Don't just change what you hear. Change the way you experience the world of Stardew Valley.
[b][color=#ffff00]Thank you[/color][/b] for taking the time to explore [color=#8e7cc3][b]I[/b][/color][b][color=#8e7cc3]mmersive Music — Complete Edition[/color][/b]. [color=#6aa84f][b]Wishing you truly relaxing adventures in the valley![/b][/color]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53735/53735-1791712214-2099991356.jpg[/img]
[quote][center][color=#b6b6b6][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]🔮 FUTURE PLANS [/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote]There are still many exciting things to explore with [b][color=#8e7cc3][font=Comic Sans MS]Immersive Music — Complete Edition![/font][/color][/b] 🌱
I hope to continue expanding the music system, introducing new experiences, and providing more options so players can create a [b][color=#ffd966][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley[/font][/color][/b] world that reflects their own personal style.

[heading]💡 [color=#ffe599]Planned Updates[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]❤️ [b][color=#e06666]Low Health Music:[/color][/b] Continue refining and expanding the low-health music system to make dangerous situations feel more tense, immersive, and impactful.[/*]
[*]🏠 [b][color=#e69138]Interior Music:[/color][/b] Introduce more dedicated music groups for indoor environments, giving different interiors a more distinctive atmosphere.[/*]
[*]🛍️ [b][color=#6d9eeb]Pierre’s General Store & JojaMart:[/color][/b] Add unique music themes for [color=#f1c232]Pierre’s General Store[/color] and [color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart[/color], giving each location its own musical identity.[/*]
[*]🏛️ [b][color=#999999]Community Center:[/color][/b] Introduce a dedicated music theme for the [color=#999999]Community Center[/color], creating a warm, nostalgic atmosphere that complements its restoration journey.[/*]
[/list][size=4]💚[/size] [b][color=#93c47d][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]These are just plans for the future.[/font][/size][/color][/b]
Features and music packs are subject to change based on development progress, timing, and community feedback. Thank you to everyone who has shown interest in, experienced, and supported[b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS] [color=#8e7cc3]Immersive Music[/color][/font][/size][/b] throughout this journey!

[code]More music, more atmosphere, more ways to experience Stardew Valley.[/code][quote][center][heading]💬 FEEDBACK & BUG REPORTS[/heading]
[left]If you encounter any issues with music playback, track transitions, environment detection, or compatibility with expansion locations, feel free to submit feedback along with your SMAPI log and details about the affected mod.[/left]
[/center]
[/quote][heading]📦 [color=#f6b26b]REQUIREMENTS[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ffd966][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley[/font][/color][/b] (yes, don't ask me why)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files&file_id=160463][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url][/*]

[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/b][/*]
[/list][heading]📥 INSTALLATION[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] by following the instructions for your version of Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Download your preferred version of the mod and extract the downloaded archive.[/*]
[*]Place the mod folder inside your game's Mods directory:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to customize the mod's features directly in-game.[/*]
[/list][b]Please make sure to install only one version of Immersive Music at a time.[/b]
